text:
Alex (PM): ok team — new customer pilot (codename: Priority Mosaic) landed. need a quick alignment on launch criteria + cross-team sequencing. who can do a rapid dependency map?
Sam (Runtime): I can take runtime deps. main asks: pin model version, quantization plan, perf SLOs, canary fallback path.
Priya (Infra): infra requirements from sales: private VPC, 2 HSM-backed KMS keys, 90d audit log retention, and dedicated staging pool. estimate 2 infra sprints.
Jordan (Security): we'll need an entry in the compliance tracker + threat model review. HSM + audit are ok but need design doc before staging. I can review within 5 business days.
Liam (SRE): capacity questions — what QPS / concurrency are we targeting for pilot? need to size prewarm and burst slots.
Alex (PM): initial target: 200 qps peak, 50 sustained, p95 latency < 250ms for short prompts. pilot is customer-facing in US region only.
Sam (Runtime): 200 qps with p95 <250ms implies batching rules + KV cache. I want to run perf runs: need access to model artifacts and ~8A100-equivalent GPU-hours. Can infra provision ephemeral perf infra?
Priya (Infra): yes, we can schedule a perf window and carve out 8 GPU-hours. will need exact AMI + network ACLs. share a list of image + mounting steps.
Sam (Runtime): sending image + runbook in this thread in a sec. also, runtime change: add graded fallback to smaller quantized model if latency spikes. low-friction flag.
Nadia (Prod Ops): rollout asks: feature-flag gate, canary at 5% then 25% then 100% over 48h, monitor for quality regressions (prompt set v1). need owner for each gate.
Alex (PM): owners: Sam -> runtime rollout; Priya -> infra provisioning; Jordan -> security signoff; Nadia -> canary orchestration and evals.
Jordan (Security): quick note: for HSM usage we need a KMS policy and key rotation plan. also request: pen test window before GA.
Liam (SRE): on-call: who will handle emergent latency spikes during canary? we should add a runbook stub and a quick rollback path (roll back to hosted model variant).
Sam (Runtime): agree. runbook stub: if p95 > 350ms for 10m or error rate > 2% kick auto-fallback to model-lite and notify #eng-oncall.
Alex (PM): acceptance matrix draft:
```
- Security signoff: required
- Infra staging pool provisioned: required
- Perf run: p95 <= 250ms on perf harness: required
- Canary metrics: quality delta <= 3% on prompt set v1: required
- KMS/HSM key in place + audit logs: required
```

Priya (Infra): can we agree on a cutover window? infra prefers low-traffic hours: Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC.
Alex (PM): Tue works for customer — good.
Nadia (Prod Ops): QA: need a test harness with seeded prompts and automated BLEU/embedding-sim checks. also will collect cost delta.
Sam (Runtime): I'll provide perf harness repo link and a small script to run locally.
Jordan (Security): small ask: redact PII in prompts used for evals. encrypted artifacts only.
Alex (PM): noted. Sam, Priya — can you both turn this into a 1-pager with owners and a timeline by EOD tomorrow?
Sam (Runtime): yes, I'll draft runtime section.
Priya (Infra): will draft infra tasks and a provisioning checklist.
Liam (SRE): I'll add the rollback runbook + oncall contacts.
Nadia (Prod Ops): I'll produce canary gates + metric dashboard template.
Jordan (Security): I'll add compliance checklist and schedule the threat model review.
deploy-bot: scheduled: perf-window-reservation -> Tue 02:30 UTC (8 GPU-hours) (id: perf-176111).
Alex (PM): sweet — once we have the 1-pager we'll do a 30-min triage tomorrow to lock dates. thanks all :thumbsup:
Nadia (Prod Ops): FYI tagging the customer success lead @mike — please keep them in the loop for canary notifications.
Sam (Runtime): adding a small TODO: verify model quantization parity on test suite. if results diverge >2% we keep unquantized path for pilot.
Priya (Infra): dependency: private subnet needs route to audit-collector. adding ticket INF-4321.
Jordan (Security): I'll attach the compliance template link here after the threat model meeting.
Alex (PM): final ask — estimate rough effort in story points for planning board (runtime 8, infra 5, security 2, prod-ops 3, sre 2). these are guesstimates but enough to scope.
Liam (SRE): noted. I'll also prepare a short postmortem template for the pilot window.
Alex (PM): great. meeting tomorrow 10:30am PT to review 1-pager. agenda: owners, acceptance matrix, perf window, canary schedule, rollback.
Nadia (Prod Ops): will invite and include a shared doc.
Sam (Runtime): linking perf harness: https://git.internal/redwood/perf-harness (PR incoming).
Priya (Infra): opening INF-4321 and INF-4322 (HSM provisioning).
Jordan (Security): thanks — signing off for now, will follow up in doc.
Alex (PM): thanks team. if anything blocks, drop in #product-handshake or ping me directly.
